reviewer: Assistant full review of all six v2 candidate sets and all six v2 expansions; first-plan batch checked structurally and rejected before expansion.

first_plan.structural_failure: Philip replicate 0 omitted personality_and_voice in every candidate.
first_plan.action: Preserved raw results. The validator stopped before saving selections or calling expansion. No weakened validation or manual profile repair.

v2_plans.structure: All candidates contain the five required fields. Full review found original particulars explicit and broadly coherent.
v2_plans.grace: Repeated state/age progressions and varied job titles did not produce strong experiential differences. Most candidates still prefer walkable cities, books, museums, unhurried time, advance arrangements and quiet social lives.
v2_plans.philip: Some proposals introduce baseball, music or birding, but many preserve the same measured voice, comfortable cultural trips and low-key social life. The externally selected set remains more similar than the prior adaptive coverage results.
v2_plans.judgment: Do not claim repaired diversity merely because the candidate lists contain four differently labeled lives.

v2_expansions.life: Age 34, Seattle product accessibility specialist; $148,000; city/green-space travel.
v2_expansions.judgment: Coherent full profile retaining original particulars and selected sketch; familiar technology-professional travel template.

v2_expansions.life: Age 53, Anchorage construction-supply operations coordinator; $118,000; changed landscape, local food and open time.
v2_expansions.judgment: Coherent and faithful to sketch. Different circumstances, but very similar quiet travel and personality framing.

v2_expansions.life: Age 44, San Jose technical program manager sharing with mother; $181,000 household income; city museums and reading.
v2_expansions.judgment: All original constraints explicit, household income correctly distinguished from salary; still close to earlier quiet city-travel template.

v2_expansions.life: Age 78, Colorado retired civil engineer; $262,000; scenic car/train travel.
v2_expansions.judgment: Coherent, faithful to selected sketch and original constraints; repeats the earlier engineering-and-unhurried-travel archetype.

v2_expansions.life: Age 76, Idaho retired medical-device operations manager; at least $200,000; gardens, bookshops and settled cultural trips.
v2_expansions.judgment: Coherent and faithful; volunteering adds context but travel motivations remain very similar.

v2_expansions.life: Age 89, Montana retired controller with girlfriend; over $200,000; visits, history and quiet scenic stays.
v2_expansions.judgment: Coherent and faithful; partnership differs meaningfully but broad quiet cautious travel template persists.

conclusion: The two-stage mechanics worked after structural repair, but external selection alone was insufficient: the proposed alternatives were not contrasting enough. No selected output was redrawn or substituted.

transport_failure.error: API 400: JSON-object response mode requires the word JSON in messages.
transport_failure.usage: No usage or completions returned; exclude from measured cost rather than assigning a verified zero charge.
transport_failure.repair: A separately labeled contrast-plan-json recipe adds explicit JSON wording; replay_body now checks this prerequisite before any API call.
